repaired_failures.repair_summary: Added a resolver compatibility class for the legacy LOCAL-13 non-git temporary checkout harness at eureka-clean-machine-*/checkout/eureka-instance while keeping normal repo-nested instance roots rejected.
repaired_failures.root_cause: The clean-machine bootstrap harness creates a filtered temporary source copy without .git and initializes checkout/eureka-instance; INSTANCE-LAYOUT-01 rejected every repo-nested path before recognizing this harness as ephemeral proof state.
repaired_failures.why_repair_is_instance_layout_only: The repair only changes path classification for the LOCAL-13 temporary checkout proof shape and adds path resolver coverage; it does not move operator state, change default paths, or modify source/search behavior.

repaired_failures.repair_summary: Allowed the same LOCAL-13 temporary checkout compatibility path through the shared resolver used by runtime status and local server startup.
repaired_failures.root_cause: The clean-machine validator reuses the temporary checkout/eureka-instance path for smoke testing; the local server path resolver rejected that path as repo-nested before the smoke could start.
repaired_failures.why_repair_is_instance_layout_only: The repair preserves ../instances/default as the preferred default, preserves explicit legacy sibling support, and only recognizes the local clean-machine proof harness as non-operator ephemeral state.
